items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: He was a trumpet player. And he hired me to play several jobs, you know? So one day, one of the boys in the band told me it was John Kasmer.

ctx.x: He was a trumpet player. And he hired me to play several jobs, you know? So one day, one of the boys in the band told me it was John Kasmer. He said, man, he said, Vic gonna fire you. I said, what? He said, man, Vic want a banjo player. He's gonna get a banjo playing his band. He said, you don't play banjo, you play guitar. I said, yeah, well, that's right. I wasn't too particular, you know, I wasn't too worried about it. I was working and I said, well, I wasn't worried about it anymore. So my wife said to me one…
That was the Vega? That was the Vega banjo.
